stripDirectives.reason: SPECIFICATION 5.2: product vector search is not part of the first v2 consumer release; v2 declares no @vector, stripped defensively so no provider wiring can appear
no approved product search use case in this release (GRAPHQL-CLIENT lever table); generation is not index readiness

omitTypes.reason: operational acquisition log (tool/HTTP attempts, request digests, error text); belongs to ingestion custody, not the product read API

omitFields.reason: operational lineage (Mission Control run id of the last writer) on every node and edge-properties type; authoritative lineage stays WAS_GENERATED_BY
operational run bookkeeping (Mission Control run id)
operational run bookkeeping (Knowledge Services operation ids)
internal object-store key of captured bytes (R-37: internal)
storage location of registered report bytes; consumers receive bodyDigest, body delivery is a product/BFF concern

conditionalFields.reason: MD-D10-06 / release rules/projection-rules.yaml decisionCriterionPublisherUid: the publisherUid cache is projected only together with its three generated stamps; otherwise omitted and the publisher is resolved through the authorizing Assertion

privateFieldPatterns.reason: OD-17: no private-person or contact details in the product projection; any such field in a pinned release is stripped (and listed in the build report) rather than served

interfaceFields.reason: every Subjectable implementer is an Entity and already stores privacyClass; exposing it on the interface lets safelisted relationship predicates through Subjectable carry the server-bound visibility condition (installed 7.6.3 does not apply @authorization filters inside relationship filter predicates)

unions.reason: installed 7.6.3 applies no @limit to union targets; union root queries are unbounded and unused by the safelist

types.reason: interface root query over ~60 labels; no supported operation needs it (entity card uses the Entity root)
entity card resolves one uid through the Entity list root; an all-label connection/totalCount is an unused costly entry point

visibility.reason: PrivacyClass: null is not public (fail closed). Every @node type gets @authorization filter rules: PUBLIC for every verified actor, INTERNAL only when the verified actor context carries internal=true. Safelisted relationship predicates additionally bind privacyClass to the server-supplied actor visibility.

scalarCuts.rule: Remove value filters (@filterable(byValue: false, byAggregate: false)) and sorting (@sortable(byValue: false)) from scalar fields on @node and edge-properties types that no safelisted operation filters or sorts on. Derived by `pnpm api:projection:cuts` from operations/catalog.json against the uncut executable; alwaysKeep fields stay filterable/sortable.
